# Glass Rainbow Effects — Liquid Glass + Rainbow Border

Skill tổng hợp **2 hiệu ứng hot nhất 2025-2026**: **Liquid Glass** (Apple iOS 26 style) + **Rainbow Border** (conic-gradient animated). Copy-paste là chạy, không cần lib, progressive enhancement, a11y đầy đủ.

> Tổng hợp từ: `dabit3/liquid-glass-web-skill` (Liquid Glass web) + `Tamoza4/apple-ui-design` (Apple glassmorphism) + `dabaibian/css-skills` (hover/border) + `joepUI/motion-ref-skill` (ambient glow). Đã chắt lọc cho web thuần HTML/CSS/JS.

- User nói: `liquid glass`, `glassmorphism`, `frosted glass`, `kính mờ`, `rainbow border`, `viền cầu vồng`, `gradient border`, `animated border`, `glass card`, `glass navbar`

- Cần viền cầu vồng tĩnh hoặc xoay, glow, neon
- Muốn combo **glass + rainbow** cho hero/CTA premium

## Workflow (3 bước)

1. **Chọn material**: Liquid Glass cho nav/controls, Rainbow cho border/CTA, combo cho hero
2. **Copy tokens + class** từ §1-§3, dán vào project (đã có CSS variables, responsive, a11y)

## 1) Design Tokens (dán 1 lần vào `:root`)

```css
:root {
  /* — Liquid Glass — */
  --glass-blur: 12px;
  --glass-saturate: 180%;
  --glass-fill: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);
  --glass-rim: rgb(255 255 255 / 25%);
  --glass-highlight: rgb(255 255 255 / 40%);
  --glass-shadow: rgb(0 0 0 / 15%);
  --glass-radius: 999px; /* capsule default */
  --glass-tint: transparent;

  /* — Rainbow — */
  --rainbow: conic-gradient(from var(--angle, 0deg), #ff3b30, #ff9500, #ffcc02, #34c759, #007aff, #af52de, #ff3b30);
  --rainbow-soft: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff3b30, #ff9500, #ffcc02, #34c759, #007aff, #af52de);
  --border-w: 2px;
  --radius: 16px;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --glass-fill: rgb(28 28 30 / 55%);
    --glass-rim: rgb(255 255 255 / 15%);
    --glass-shadow: rgb(0 0 0 / 35%);
  }
}
```

## 2) Liquid Glass — Material cho Navigation Layer

> **Quy tắc vàng**: Glass chỉ cho **navigation layer** (header, toolbar, tab bar, button, sheet) — KHÔNG cho content (article, grid, table). Phải có content phía sau để sample.

### 2.1 Base Glass (capsule mặc định)

```css
.glass {
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--glass-tint), var(--glass-tint)),
    var(--glass-fill);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-saturate));
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-saturate));
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-rim);
  border-radius: var(--glass-radius);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 8%),
    0 8px 24px var(--glass-shadow);
}
```

```html
<span class="glass" style="padding:8px 16px">Label</span>
<button class="glass" style="--glass-radius:16px; padding:10px 20px">Rounded</button>
<button class="glass" style="--glass-tint: rgb(0 122 255 / 22%); color:white">Tinted</button>
```

**Variants:**
```css
.glass-clear { --glass-blur: 6px; --glass-fill: rgb(255 255 255 / 4%); --glass-rim: rgb(255 255 255 / 15%); }
.glass-identity { background:none; -webkit-backdrop-filter:none; backdrop-filter:none; border-color:transparent; box-shadow:none; }
```

### 2.2 Shared Surface (BẮT BUỘC khi nhiều nút gần nhau)

Mỗi `backdrop-filter` là 1 snapshot riêng — nhiều glass chồng nhau = double-filter + giật. Gom vào 1 container:

```html
<!-- ❌ BAD: 3 snapshots -->
<button class="glass">A</button><button class="glass">B</button><button class="glass">C</button>

<!-- ✅ GOOD: 1 surface -->
<div class="glass toolbar-group" role="group" style="display:flex; gap:4px; padding:4px">
  <button style="background:none; border:none; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:inherit">A</button>
  <button style="background:none; border:none; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:inherit">B</button>
  <button style="background:none; border:none; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:inherit">C</button>
</div>
```

### 2.7 Refraction (Chromium-only, progressive)

```html
<svg width="0" height="0" aria-hidden="true">
  <filter id="liquid-lens">
    <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.008 0.008" numOctaves="2" seed="7" result="noise"/>
    <feGaussianBlur in="noise" stdDeviation="2" result="soft"/>
    <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="soft" scale="48" xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G"/>
  </filter>
</svg>
```
```css
@supports (backdrop-filter: url(#liquid-lens)) {
  .glass-refract { backdrop-filter: url(#liquid-lens) blur(4px) saturate(var(--glass-saturate)); }
}
```

## 3) Rainbow Border — 4 Kỹ thuật (chọn 1)

### 3.1 Tĩnh — conic-gradient qua pseudo (khuyên dùng, bo góc đẹp)

```css
.rainbow-border {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--card-bg, white);
  /* fallback nếu không có mask support */
}
.rainbow-border::before {
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0;
  border-radius: inherit; padding: var(--border-w);
  background: conic-gradient(from var(--angle, 0deg), #ff3b30, #ff9500, #ffcc02, #34c759, #007aff, #af52de, #ff3b30);
  /* mask để chỉ hiện viền */
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
}
```

### 3.2 Tĩnh — border-image (nhanh, nhưng bo góc hạn chế)

```css
.rainbow-border-image {
  border: 3px solid transparent;
  border-image: conic-gradient(from 0deg, #ff3b30, #ff9500, #ffcc02, #34c759, #007aff, #af52de, #ff3b30) 1;
  border-radius: var(--radius); /* cần overflow hidden nếu muốn bo */
}
```

### 3.3 Animated xoay — @property + conic-gradient (HOT nhất)

```css
@property --angle { syntax:"<angle>"; initial-value:0deg; inherits:false; }

.rainbow-animated {
  position: relative; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--card-bg, white);
}
.rainbow-animated::before {
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; padding:var(--border-w);
  background: conic-gradient(from var(--angle), #ff3b30, #ff9500, #ffcc02, #34c759, #007aff, #af52de, #ff3b30);
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude;
  animation: rotate 3s linear infinite;
  pointer-events:none;
}
@keyframes rotate { to { --angle: 360deg; } }

/* Hover-only version */
.rainbow-hover::before { animation-play-state: paused; }
.rainbow-hover:hover::before { animation-play-state: running; }
```

> **Lưu ý (KN-003):** Detect `@property` bằng `typeof CSS.registerProperty === 'function'`, KHÔNG dùng `CSS.supports('syntax: "<angle>"')` (luôn false). Dùng gradient trực tiếp `conic-gradient(from var(--angle), ...)` tại `::before` — không qua biến `var(--rainbow)` lồng (một số engine không re-resolve `var()` lồng). Fallback JS (set `--angle` bằng rAF) gắn class ở `<html>` (`.js-rainbow`), không per-element.

### 3.4 Glow Rainbow (cho dark premium)

```css
.rainbow-glow {
  position:relative; border-radius:var(--radius); background:#0a0a0f; color:white;
  border:1px solid transparent;
}
.rainbow-glow::before {
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:-2px; border-radius:inherit; z-index:-1;
  background: conic-gradient(from var(--angle, 0deg), #ff3b30, #ff9500, #ffcc02, #34c759, #007aff, #af52de, #ff3b30);
  filter: blur(8px); opacity:0.7; transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}
.rainbow-glow:hover::before { opacity:1; filter: blur(12px); }
```

## 4) Combo — Glass + Rainbow (Premium Hero/CTA)

```css
.glass-rainbow {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 20px;
  /* glass */
  background: linear-gradient(var(--glass-tint), var(--glass-tint)), var(--glass-fill);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-saturate));
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-saturate));
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-highlight), 0 8px 24px var(--glass-shadow);
}
.glass-rainbow::before {
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; padding:1.5px;
  background: conic-gradient(from var(--angle, 0deg), #ff3b30, #ff9500, #ffcc02, #34c759, #007aff, #af52de, #ff3b30);
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events:none; opacity:0.9;
}
.glass-rainbow.animated::before { animation: rotate 4s linear infinite; }
```

```html
<div class="glass-rainbow animated" style="padding:24px; max-width:480px">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">Premium Glass + Rainbow</h3>
  <p style="margin:0; opacity:0.8">Kính mờ + viền cầu vồng xoay — dùng cho pricing hero, CTA.</p>
</div>
```

## 5) A11y & Performance (BẮT BUỘC)

```css
/* Giảm chuyển động */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
  .rainbow-animated::before { animation: none !important; }
}

/* Giảm trong suốt (người nhạy cảm) */
@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
  .glass, .glass-rainbow { -webkit-backdrop-filter:none; backdrop-filter:none; background: var(--card-bg, white); }
}

/* High contrast */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .glass, .rainbow-border::before, .rainbow-animated::before { border: 2px solid CanvasText; }
}

/* Focus */
.glass:focus-visible, .rainbow-border:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a84ff; outline-offset: 2px; }
```

**Performance:**
- 1 glass surface / cluster (đừng mỗi button 1 glass)
- Không animate `backdrop-filter` hay `blur` — chỉ animate `transform`/`opacity`/`--angle`
- Giảm `--glass-blur` xuống 6-8px trên mobile
- Rainbow animated: chỉ dùng cho 1-2 CTA/page, không cho list dài

**Browser:**
- `backdrop-filter`: Chrome 76+, Edge 79+, Firefox 103+, Safari 9+ (`-webkit-` prefix) — luôn ship cả 2
- `conic-gradient`: Chrome 69+, Safari 12.1+, Firefox 83+
- `@property`: Chrome 85+, Safari 16.4+ — fallback: animation vẫn chạy nhưng không mượt bằng
- SVG `url(#filter)` trong backdrop: Chromium-only
